_mirwik_: Nobody saw Gideon Mirwik arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-S16, and a quiet stretcher bearer under it.
Gideon Mirwik saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

Gideon Mirwik threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Rafael Broadshoulde was down and screaming for a medic. (@broadshoulderedbastard) No rifles, only shovels and knives. Gideon Mirwik dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Albin Donaldgregor coming out. It was over in seconds. (@donaldgregory334) Gideon Mirwik made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Gideon Mirwik crawled the last yards. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Gideon Mirwik kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Mirwik. Gideon Mirwik read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Gideon Mirwik is whole again, or near enough for the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Mirwik. Gideon Mirwik read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gideon Mirwik answered to number 578. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gideon Mirwik watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Gideon Mirwik held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Mirwik. Gideon Mirwik read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet grazed Gideon Mirwik's ribs at S-S16. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Roland Customs of the Hegemony (@_cs__customs_). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon Mirwik. Gideon Mirwik read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Three days with a bandage, and Gideon Mirwik is back at S-S16. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Gideon Mirwik splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Gideon Mirwik's ear at S-S16 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins). A letter reached Gideon Mirwik with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Gideon Mirwik tried to as well.
Gideon Mirwik's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
art.by.calin.deskodt: Wendel Deskodt unpacked a pocket Bible with a hole in it at V-F13. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Wendel Deskodt wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Severin "Lucky" Light and Wendel Deskodt made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Wendel Deskodt put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
Wendel Deskodt shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Wendel Deskodt wrote letters for men who could not write, and some for men who could but did not know the words.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Wendel Deskodt was hit hard in the fight at V-F13 before anyone could fire. The raider was Casimir Singh of the Hegemony. Raider: Casimir Singh of the Hegemony (@aishwarya.singh_05). Wendel Deskodt held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Roland Deskodt took the same post at V-F13 where Wendel Deskodt stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Roland Deskodt heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
asmodeus2008: Clement Asmodeus joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Clement Asmodeus let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Clement Asmodeus did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Clement Asmodeus fired back. Tobias Jacckk was badly wounded. Clement Asmodeus walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Fresh from training, Clement Asmodeus still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Pavel Wallstercorn, grazed. Clement Asmodeus fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Rafael Carwyn was grazed. Clement Asmodeus ate breakfast without a word.
Clement Asmodeus tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
Clement Asmodeus found a chair in the barn and sat down carefully, as if it might be reserved for someone of higher rank.
Clement Asmodeus has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

Clement Asmodeus fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Tobias Jacckk was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. The sergeant at S-R3 called out a range and a spot. Clement Asmodeus was the only one who hit it. Norbert Cipowski was gravely wounded.

Clement Asmodeus was hit through the stomach at S-R3. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Florian Mw of the Concord (@m.w_1254). Clement Asmodeus finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. Clement Asmodeus's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week.
axelnahumury: Emil Axelnahumury joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Emil Axelnahumury helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. Orders came through: Emil Axelnahumury is a signaller now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a lock of hair in a matchbox.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Emil Axelnahumury could not stop listening to it. A letter from home reached Emil Axelnahumury before dusk. Emil Axelnahumury read it twice and slept a little easier. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Emil Axelnahumury during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Emil Axelnahumury offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last. A letter from home reached Emil Axelnahumury before dusk. Emil Axelnahumury read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Brickworks. Ulrich David fired. Emil Axelnahumury pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' A letter from home reached Emil Axelnahumury before dusk. Emil Axelnahumury read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Emil Axelnahumury was hit in the foot through his boot at T-F14. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. A letter from home reached Emil Axelnahumury before dusk. Emil Axelnahumury read it twice and slept a little easier.

Emil Axelnahumury lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Emil Axelnahumury before dusk. Emil Axelnahumury read it twice and slept a little easier.

A medic stopped by Emil Axelnahumury's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Emil Axelnahumury had gone back to T-F14. A short letter reached Emil Axelnahumury: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Emil Axelnahumury read the part about the dog twice.

Emil Axelnahumury saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. A letter from home reached Emil Axelnahumury before dusk. Emil Axelnahumury read it twice and slept a little easier. The stretcher bearers took Emil Axelnahumury in on a busy morning in T-F14. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.
bevis.44: "You're late," said the corporal when Casimir "Saint" Bevis arrived on Day 5. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Rumour reached R-S6 that the war would be over by spring. Casimir "Saint" Bevis has heard it before. So has everyone.

Casimir "Saint" Bevis repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at R-S6 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Saint" Bevis. Casimir "Saint" Bevis read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Casimir "Saint" Bevis asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Casimir "Saint" Bevis ate two helpings anyway.

Casimir "Saint" Bevis checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Saint" Bevis. Casimir "Saint" Bevis read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Casimir "Saint" Bevis could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Saint" Bevis. Casimir "Saint" Bevis read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir "Saint" Bevis saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Gideon "Mole" Deale, grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Casimir "Saint" Bevis is number 432. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Casimir "Saint" Bevis during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Casimir "Saint" Bevis saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-S6 and fired once. Pavel Schwols was badly wounded. Casimir "Saint" Bevis fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Lucien Kattawar, now grazed.
Two men fed the belt while Casimir "Saint" Bevis held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Felix "Whistle" Mart was gravely wounded.

Casimir "Saint" Bevis swept the enemy parapet at R-S6 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Viktor Thompson was grazed. Casimir "Saint" Bevis was hit through the chest at R-S6. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Benedikt Aidanthompso of the Concord (@aidanthompson0319). Casimir "Saint" Bevis was killed outright at R-S6, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Benedikt Aidanthompso of the Concord (@aidanthompson0319).
The House of Bevis sent Dorian Bevis after Casimir "Saint" Bevis. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Dorian Bevis lost a boot in the trench. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Dorian Bevis lay in the ruins of Blackwater Canal from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory.
Dorian Bevis sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
drowning_in_minis: Nils Minis reported to Q-F22 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Nils Minis of the Hegemony and Benedikt Lzed of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Drowned Farm. It is getting crowded. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Nils Minis watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Nils Minis reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F22 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Clement "Owl" Audio of the Concord (@dean.anthony.audio).
Nils Minis returned to Q-F22 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Nils Minis lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
Nils Minis kept Jakub Relations awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Nils could have walked there blind.
Nils Minis made it into the enemy trench and out again. Twenty yards from home, a single shot ended it. Killed in the night raid by Clement "Owl" Audio of the Concord (@dean.anthony.audio).
The House of Minis sent Marek "Ghost" Minis after Nils Minis. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Marek "Ghost" Minis had Leopold Evans of the Concord in the sights at the Drowned Farm for a long second. Leopold Evans was lighting a pipe. Marek "Ghost" Minis let the match burn all the way down.
firekeyboard: The new sniper is Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard, once a baker from Brennmoor. The corporal asked if a baker was any use in a trench. Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard said he would find out.

Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard fired. Albin "Saint" Aruuki was grazed. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F9. Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard has learned to walk bent double.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard aimed just below it. Albin "Spark" Cloud was badly wounded. Grey Mill is lost. Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The order named Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch.
Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud was grazed.
Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard (Concord) and Jakub Damocles (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at the Hanging Bridge at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow.
Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F9. Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
gilley_monsta00: Silas Monsta was a railway porter in Belmonte until the posters went up. He came to T-F5 with a letter he never sent, and within a day the whole squad knew that he talks to his rifle.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Silas Monsta heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Silas Monsta. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Silas Monsta wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Gideon "Rabbit" Deer and Silas Monsta tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
The cook borrowed Silas Monsta's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Ossuary Wood every night, fed by Silas Monsta on one side and Dorian "Tin" Gtbeep on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.

Silas Monsta was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Leopold "Parson" Carlosm of the Hegemony (@carlosm.jr).
Silas Monsta rejoined the squad at T-F5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Silas Monsta tried to remember the price of a loaf in Belmonte. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
isaiahfs21: Silas Isaiahfs found a place in Q-F2 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Silas Isaiahfs won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in Q-F2. The lance corporal wants a rematch. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Silas Isaiahfs during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Rematch. Silas Isaiahfs lost everything he won, plus a stub of a pencil. The whole dugout watched.
Silas Isaiahfs dreamt he was back in Greyhallow, working as a ferryman. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
A clear shot from Q-F2. Silas Isaiahfs grazed Edmund Kryvolap and slid back down below the parapet.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Silas Isaiahfs won back a stub of a pencil and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
There is a sniper across the way the men call the Magpie. Three helmets went up on sticks today. the Magpie hit all three. Silas Isaiahfs watched where the shots came from.
Silas Isaiahfs had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Rafael Grenades was badly wounded.
justinsoups: Severin "Doc" Justinsoups unpacked a child's drawing of a horse at R-S13. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Severin "Doc" Justinsoups started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-S13. Severin "Doc" Justinsoups has learned to walk bent double.

Severin "Doc" Justinsoups's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point." The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Severin "Doc" Justinsoups answered to number 506. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Severin "Doc" Justinsoups kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
The corporal found out Severin "Doc" Justinsoups used to be a dance-hall violinist. Severin "Doc" Justinsoups has been doing two jobs ever since.
The party came back from the Chalk Pits by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Severin "Doc" Justinsoups.

Severin "Doc" Justinsoups crawled back into R-S13 at dawn after two nights in a shell hole at the Bone Quarry, covered in mud and carrying a child's drawing of a horse. He asked if he had missed breakfast.
A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Severin "Doc" Justinsoups's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Severin "Doc" Justinsoups did not make a sound.
Machine-gun fire swept R-S13. Severin "Doc" Justinsoups took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Hugo Rankine of the Hegemony (@rankine_459.67).
There was no room for Severin "Doc" Justinsoups. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
A letter came with Henrik Justinsoups: "I am Severin "Doc" Justinsoups's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
luccisan191: Nobody saw Felix Luccisan arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in Q-F15, and a quiet sniper under it.

Felix Luccisan spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow. A letter from home reached Felix Luccisan before dusk. Felix Luccisan read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill has been won. Felix Luccisan listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Felix Luccisan waited for that to change. When it did, Bram "Parson" Dumbasian was grazed. Dawn watch. Felix Luccisan put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Yann Ferkans, gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Felix Luccisan before dusk. Felix Luccisan read it twice and slept a little easier.
Felix Luccisan caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Felix Luccisan helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Felix Luccisan was waiting. Emil "Mole" Assembly was grazed. A bullet went through Felix Luccisan's upper arm at Q-F15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Norbert "Hollow" Viking of the Concord (@nordmann_i_viking). Felix Luccisan stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F15. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Norbert "Hollow" Viking of the Concord (@nordmann_i_viking).
Pavel Luccisan arrived carrying the family name of Felix Luccisan. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Pavel Luccisan dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
Pavel Luccisan hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
odysseus_murphy: Bastian Murphy joined the replacements on Day 11. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Bastian Murphy during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Bastian Murphy thought about a teacher who said he would amount to nothing on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
Bastian Murphy delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.
Bastian Murphy tried to remember the price of a loaf in Stoneyford. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Bastian Murphy ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At U-F7 they left Bastian Murphy behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Pavel Hite of the Concord (@kigh_as_a_hite).
A letter came with Ivo Murphy: "I am Bastian Murphy's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Ivo Murphy got a letter from Rosa. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
paiola.simone: Bram Simone told the sergeant he was a ferryman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Bram Simone did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Bram Simone in the open at U-F20. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Albin Rjk of the Concord (@rjk7747). Bram Simone was killed on watch at U-F20. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Albin Rjk of the Concord (@rjk7747).
Arno Simone came to the front because his father Bram Simone never came home. He carries a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Arno Simone. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.

Arno Simone saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at U-F20 and fired once. Bastian Realjospence was badly wounded. A bullet clipped Arno Simone's helmet at U-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Arno "Whistle" Oli of the Concord (@oli.c.h_1944). Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno Simone. Arno Simone read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Arno Simone took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at U-F20, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Anselm Ofsoup of the Concord (@sea_ofsoup). Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno Simone. Arno Simone read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Arno Simone drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. Arno Simone read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Arno Simone. He died on the stretcher before morning.

The papers say Gideon Simone. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Arno Simone's eyes. Nobody in U-F20 argues. Gideon Simone reported for duty as a signaller. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
patrick.t.mcgrail: Silas Mcgrail arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a lucky button and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Silas Mcgrail heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Mcgrail. Silas Mcgrail read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick and Silas Mcgrail split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Silas Mcgrail wrote to a wife and a daughter he has never met that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Silas Mcgrail checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Mcgrail. Silas Mcgrail read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The sergeant at Q-F12 called out a range and a spot. Silas Mcgrail was the only one who hit it. Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby was grazed.
The whole squad at Q-F12 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Silas Mcgrail's bullet that found Gustav Anish, badly wounded.

Silas Mcgrail fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Zeno Vpadlu was badly wounded. Silas Mcgrail ate breakfast without a word. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Mcgrail. Silas Mcgrail read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Silas Mcgrail was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Casimir Chickenman was badly wounded.

Silas Mcgrail heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. There was a letter for Silas Mcgrail and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
pentacatholic: The draft reached T-F17 on Day 9. Teodor Pentacatholi was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Teodor Pentacatholi wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Teodor Pentacatholi's ear at T-F17 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Roland Gethectoredb of the Hegemony (@gethectoredbruh). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Teodor Pentacatholi read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The wound on Teodor Pentacatholi's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Teodor Pentacatholi found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Teodor Pentacatholi took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Teodor Pentacatholi found an old map of Grey Mill from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Teodor Pentacatholi borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Teodor Pentacatholi received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
pst13606: Walter Pst arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a lucky button and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Walter Pst lay behind a dead tree trunk at S-C15 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Severin Kowalien was badly wounded. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter Pst helped stack spare sandbags at S-C15. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home found Walter Pst before the night shift. Walter Pst folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Pst spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow. A letter from home found Walter Pst before the night shift. Walter Pst folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Walter Pst is number 724. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Walter Pst watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Walter Pst noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
Walter Pst borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Walter Pst took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
A crow sat on the parapet above Walter Pst all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at S-C15. Walter Pst saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Zeno Iqsanislami was gravely wounded.
Walter Pst had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Marek Kowalien was gravely wounded.
raumeidechse: Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse arrived with the Day 6 draft, carrying a photograph gone soft at the edges and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse saw Valentin Thorholting freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Doc said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. A letter from home reached Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse before dusk. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse read it twice and slept a little easier.
Fog so thick that Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse felt a hard tug at his hip at S-S7. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Zeno Ghostoftheas of the Hegemony (@ghostoftheast). Two shots, one miss. The second found Edmund Matteozrybak, badly wounded. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse answered to number 422. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-S7 with the rations. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse ate while listening to the revised orders.
Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse rejoined the squad at S-S7. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse fired, and Ulrich Chloe was badly wounded.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Gustav Elliott, was badly wounded.
Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse aimed a step ahead and fired: Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear, gravely wounded.
ronne_02: Viktor Ronne came up the line with a tin of tobacco and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Machine-gun fire swept S-R12. Viktor Ronne took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Viktor Ronne fell at S-R12 and never moved again. Shot by Wendel "Hollow" Arthur of the Hegemony (@arthur.ds999).
The papers say Jakub Ronne. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Viktor Ronne's eyes. Nobody in S-R12 argues.

Jakub Ronne has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Matthias Fxx, badly wounded. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Jakub Ronne across the shin at S-R12. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Jonas Fabian of the Hegemony (@itz_fabian0120). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jakub Ronne is number 860. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Ronne stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The medics cleaned Jakub Ronne's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-R12.
Marek "Lucky" Pablo kept Jakub Ronne awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Lucky could have walked there blind.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Jakub Ronne's ear at S-R12 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Roland Serreno of the Hegemony (@anabelen.serreno).

The men at S-R12 heard Jakub Ronne call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Hugo Mrcakerson of the Hegemony (@mrcakerson). Jakub Ronne was killed at S-R12 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Hugo Mrcakerson of the Hegemony (@mrcakerson).
Bastian Ronne arrived carrying the family name of Jakub Ronne. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
In reserve, Bastian Ronne slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part.

Bastian Ronne fired at a movement across the wire at S-R12. The man went down: Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti, gravely wounded. Bastian Ronne was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R12. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921). Bastian Ronne was killed at S-R12 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Silas Menezes of the Hegemony (@julio.menezes921).
The papers connected Norbert Ronne to Bastian Ronne. The men took longer to learn Norbert Ronne's own habits, but they made the effort.
tallas154: "You're late," said the corporal when Silas "Spark" Tallas arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Silas "Spark" Tallas fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Rafael Tmpar did not get to reply at all, grazed. Silas "Spark" Tallas smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Edmund Swag came out for a cup and was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas "Spark" Tallas. Silas "Spark" Tallas read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Grey Mill. Silas "Spark" Tallas let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at Calvary Farm, Silas "Spark" Tallas was promoted to Lance Corporal.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Silas "Spark" Tallas has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas "Spark" Tallas. Silas "Spark" Tallas read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Silas "Spark" Tallas asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
The gun crews at T-F4 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Cyril Duncan was grazed.
Silas "Spark" Tallas and Ulrich Djsunspear both swear they saw a ghost at the Chalk Pits. Each says the other screamed first.
Silas "Spark" Tallas fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Silas "Tin" Roman was badly wounded trying to cross it.
